info.title: Superior Trade API
info.description:
The cloud runtime for algorithmic trading strategies. Superior Trade runs your Freqtrade and NautilusTrader strategies as managed, always-on deployments — wallets, exchange credentials, order routing, and monitoring handled for you.

**What this API does:**
- **Backtest** strategies against real exchange history before any capital moves
- **Deploy** strategies as managed live (or paper) runtimes — one call, no servers
- **Wallets & funding** — platform-managed trading wallets, gasless deposits, builder-fee handling
- **Venues** — Hyperliquid perps/spot (Freqtrade, v2), Polymarket prediction markets (NautilusTrader, v3), and feature-gated Lighter funding/readiness APIs

**How these docs are organized — which group do I use?**

The sidebar has two main groups. They are not old-vs-new versions — they are two engines on two venues:
- **v2 — Freqtrade · Hyperliquid**: run Freqtrade (Python) strategies on Hyperliquid perps/spot. Backtesting, live + paper deployments, funding, intelligence. **Most integrations start here.**
- **v3 — Nautilus · Polymarket**: run NautilusTrader strategies on Polymarket prediction markets, plus the cross-venue account bootstrap/onboarding endpoints (the `/v3/account/{address}/hyperliquid` bootstrap is used by v2 integrations too).
- **v3 — Lighter**: Superior-wallet CCTP funding, account readiness, and secure withdrawals back to the Superior wallet. Lighter creates the venue account on first credited deposit.
- **Legacy v1** (bottom of the sidebar) is deprecated; do not build against it.

Pick the venue you trade, work inside that group, and dip into the other only for the account bootstrap.

**Auth (two ways, one header each):**
- API key from [account.superior.trade](https://account.superior.trade) → `x-api-key: st_live_…`
- Privy session JWT (terminal users) → `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`

**Quickstart — zero to live deploy:**
1. Create an API key at [account.superior.trade](https://account.superior.trade)
2. `POST /v2/backtesting` with your Freqtrade strategy code → poll `GET /v2/backtesting/{id}/status`, fetch results via `resultUrl` (fall back to `GET /{id}/logs` for the run summary)
3. Fund your trading account: `POST /v3/account/{address}/hyperliquid` (one-time bootstrap — creates the agent wallet, approves the builder fee) then `POST /v2/portfolio/hyperliquid/deposit`
4. `POST /v2/deployment` with the validated strategy → `POST /{id}/credentials` → start it (use **PATCH** `/v2/deployment/{id}/status` — see the endpoint note vs the legacy PUT)
5. Watch it: `GET /v2/deployment/{id}/status` and `/logs`

Paper trading is identical via `/v2/paper-deployment` — same strategy code, simulated fills, no funding required.

**Roadmap — more integrations coming:**
- **NautilusTrader · Binance** — the Nautilus engine pointed at Binance markets.
- **Intelligence Buckets deploy API** — deploy self-updating pair universes as a single strategy.

post.description:
Stores exchange API credentials for a deployment. Supports two modes:

1. **Account Main Private Key**: Use the main account's private key - both `private_key` and `wallet_address` should be from the main account.

2. **API Wallet Private Key**: Use an API wallet's private key - `private_key` is from the API wallet, but `wallet_address` must still be from the main account (for signing transactions).

from freqtrade.strategy import IStrategy
from pandas import DataFrame

class HyperliquidBtcMomentumStrategy(IStrategy):
    timeframe = "5m"
    minimal_roi = {"0": 0.02}
    stoploss = -0.04
    startup_candle_count = 50

    def populate_indicators(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe["ema_fast"] = dataframe["close"].ewm(span=12).mean()
        dataframe["ema_slow"] = dataframe["close"].ewm(span=26).mean()
        return dataframe

    def populate_entry_trend(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe.loc[dataframe["ema_fast"] > dataframe["ema_slow"], "enter_long"] = 1
        return dataframe

    def populate_exit_trend(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe.loc[dataframe["ema_fast"] < dataframe["ema_slow"], "exit_long"] = 1
        return dataframe

get.description: Returns exchange readiness for the requested account wallet. Use `hyperliquid` for referral, builder fee, and agent wallet readiness; use `polymarket` for full runtime onboarding readiness; use `lighter` for Lighter account creation, API-key provisioning, collateral, and available balance. For Polymarket, `polymarketWallet.address` is the derived Polymarket deposit wallet used for balances, funding, approvals, and CLOB funder operations. `onboarding.ready` is true only when the wallet is exportable, an active Superior API key exists, the wallet is onboarded, approvals are set, Polymarket CLOB API credentials are stored, and the wallet meets the minimum Polygon USDC balance.

from freqtrade.strategy import IStrategy
from pandas import DataFrame

class HyperliquidBtcMomentumStrategy(IStrategy):
    timeframe = "5m"
    minimal_roi = {"0": 0.02}
    stoploss = -0.04
    startup_candle_count = 50

    def populate_indicators(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe["ema_fast"] = dataframe["close"].ewm(span=12).mean()
        dataframe["ema_slow"] = dataframe["close"].ewm(span=26).mean()
        return dataframe

    def populate_entry_trend(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe.loc[dataframe["ema_fast"] > dataframe["ema_slow"], "enter_long"] = 1
        return dataframe

    def populate_exit_trend(self, dataframe: DataFrame, metadata: dict) -> DataFrame:
        dataframe.loc[dataframe["ema_fast"] < dataframe["ema_slow"], "exit_long"] = 1
        return dataframe

get.description: Returns exchange readiness for the requested account wallet. Use `hyperliquid` for referral, builder fee, and agent wallet readiness; use `polymarket` for full runtime onboarding readiness; use `lighter` for Lighter account creation, API-key provisioning, collateral, and available balance. For Polymarket, `polymarketWallet.address` is the derived Polymarket deposit wallet used for balances, funding, approvals, and CLOB funder operations. `onboarding.ready` is true only when the wallet is exportable, an active Superior API key exists, the wallet is onboarded, approvals are set, Polymarket CLOB API credentials are stored, and the wallet meets the minimum Polygon USDC balance.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Account wallet address owned by the authenticated user.

polymarketWallet.description: The derived Polymarket deposit wallet used as the CLOB funder and balance source for Polymarket status responses.

derivedFrom.description: Superior account wallet used to derive the Polymarket deposit wallet.

ready.description: True when all Polymarket runtime gates pass: exportable wallet, active Superior API key, Polymarket account row, post-wrap approvals, stored CLOB credentials, and minimum Polygon USDC balance.

apiKeyCreated.description: True when the authenticated product user has at least one active, unexpired Superior API key.

onboarded.description: True when the wallet has a Polymarket account record.

approvalsSet.description: True when required Polymarket post-wrap allowances/approvals are stored or detected on-chain.

clobCredentialsStored.description: True when Polymarket CLOB API key, secret, and passphrase are present server-side. Secret values are never returned.

credentialsStored.description: Alias for `onboarding.clobCredentialsStored`; true when CLOB credentials are stored server-side without exposing their values.

owner_address.description: Superior-managed account wallet used as the Lighter owner.

account_index.description: Lighter account index, or null before the first credited deposit creates the account.

account_ready.description: True when the Lighter account exists and collateral can be read.

api_key_ready.description: True when the Superior-managed Lighter API key is approved and stored.

ready.description: True when the Lighter account and Superior-managed API key are ready for trading.

next_action.description: Recommended next Lighter setup action, or null when ready.

available_balance.description: Lighter available balance for the owner account.

collateral.description: Lighter collateral for the owner account.

active_deposit.description: Active Lighter deposit operation when the status is deposit_pending.

api_key_approval_tx_hash.description: Lighter transaction hash for API-key approval when available.

400.description: Validation failed, unsupported exchange, or exchange setup is not ready
